reviews.text: I recently tried this cream and was really impressed with the results. The texture is smooth, lightweight, and absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling greasy. After using it for a few days, my skin felt softer, more hydrated, and looked healthier. It also has a pleasant, mild fragrance, which makes it even more enjoyable to use. Overall, it’s a great product and worth trying.
reviews.zh: 我最近試咗呢支霜，對效果真係好驚喜。質地柔滑輕盈，吸收到皮膚嘅速度好快又唔會油笠。用咗幾日之後，皮膚感覺更柔軟、更保濕，望落更健康。仲有陣舒服淡香，用嘅時候更加享受。整體嚟講係一支好產品，值得一試。

reviews.text: This is my first time using this cream, and I like it. I’m using it after the retinal serum from the same brand, and I can already see results. My skin feels moisturized, and I notice a glowing effect
reviews.zh: 我第一次用呢支霜，我鍾意。我會喺用完同一個品牌嘅 retinal 精華之後再用，已經見到效果。皮膚感覺保濕，亦有明顯嘅光澤感。

reviews.text: Fine, good, nice texture and smell waiting to see results
reviews.zh: 唔錯，幾好，質地同氣味都好好，等緊睇效果。

reviews.text: Immedietly made my skin more shiny, hydrated and clear! I recommend it to anybody!
reviews.zh: 即刻令皮膚更光澤、更保濕、更透亮！推薦畀任何人用！

reviews.text: I apply it to cleansed, toned skin, either as a final nourishing layer or under moisturizer on dry nights. One capsule is generous—enough for face, neck, and décolletage.
reviews.zh: 我會喺清潔、塗完爽膚水之後嘅皮膚上用，可以作為最後一層滋潤，或者喺乾燥嘅晚上塗喺保濕品之前。一粒膠囊嘅份量好充足 — 足夠用喺面、頸同胸口。

reviews.text: A simple, pleasant product that fits easily into my routine. It feels nice to use, performs as expected, and adds a subtle touch of improvement. Overall, I’m happy with it. ✨
reviews.zh: 一款簡單舒服嘅產品，可以輕鬆融入我嘅日常程序。用嘅感覺好，表現符合預期，帶嚟一啲微妙嘅改善。整體嚟講我好滿意。✨
